Markets.title: Anthropic IPO share orders from China are said to be rebuffed
Markets.summary: Investors in mainland China and Hong Kong are excluded from placing orders in Anthropic's upcoming initial public offering. This restriction reflects ongoing strategic tensions between Washington and Beijing regarding advancements in technology.

Markets.title: BofA adds January Fed hike to forecast, says quarterly pace no longer enough
Markets.summary: Bank of America now forecasts a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in January 2027 following a higher-than-expected October Consumer Price Index report. Other major banks, including Goldman Sachs and Deutsche Bank, have similarly revised their rate predictions due to rising inflation.

Markets.title: US stocks: US stocks reverse early gains as Nvidia turmoil hits tech sector
Markets.summary: US stocks reversed early gains and fell due to a tech sector selloff triggered by Nvidia's leadership turmoil. The Nasdaq dropped 1.42% and the S&P 500 fell nearly 1% as investors also weighed interest rate outlooks and producer inflation data.

Markets.title: Chicago Fed's Goolsbee says on CNBC the Fed needs to guard against demand overheating
Markets.summary: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee stated that rising demand from the artificial intelligence boom is driving up prices across sectors like healthcare and services. He emphasized that upcoming inflation data will determine the pace of the Federal Reserve's future interest rate increases.

Markets.title: US Treasury chief says Fed should not hike rates over energy shock tied to Iran war
Markets.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged the Federal Reserve to avoid raising interest rates in response to energy price spikes from the conflict in Iran. He stated that despite market volatility, the underlying US economy remains strong.

Markets.title: MAN Industries PAT rises to Rs 82 cr in Q2
Markets.summary: MAN Industries reported a consolidated profit after tax of Rs 82 crore for the September quarter, driven by higher revenue and the acquisition of National Pipe Company. Although shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz caused temporary impacts, the firm's overall scale and profitability improved.

Geo-Political.title: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption
Geo-Political.summary: Microsoft apologized following a nearly 24-hour global technology outage that caused widespread disruptions. Industry experts noted the incident highlights the world's heavy reliance on a small number of major technology providers.

Geo-Political.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
Geo-Political.summary: Microsoft is still working to restore global services like Outlook and Teams following a major outage. The company has not yet confirmed if any emails have been permanently lost.

Geo-Political.title: Watch: How a server outage took down Microsoft Teams and Outlook
Geo-Political.summary: A Microsoft server outage disrupted several core services, including Teams, Outlook, and the Copilot AI software. The technical failure impacted user access to these communication and productivity platforms.

Geo-Political.title: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
Geo-Political.summary: BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg reports that Vladimir Putin is increasing his demands for peace with Ukraine. Moscow views the inclusion of European security in these discussions as a victory.

Geo-Political.title: Nvidia scandal fallout widens as Trump's treasury secretary blames cabinet colleague
Geo-Political.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent blamed Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick for failing to ban Nvidia chip exports to a firm linked to China. This disagreement widened the fallout from the Nvidia export scandal within the cabinet.

Geo-Political.title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own
Geo-Political.summary: Pope Leo XIV is visiting Peru on his Latin America tour shortly after undergoing lung cancer surgery. A Peruvian city has embraced the Pope as one of its own during this visit.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This unexpected AI recommendation occurred without the use of paid advertising.

AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These technologies aim to help digital creators stay competitive and streamline their workflow.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide explains how beginners can use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: Trade deficit widens to 1-year high of $39.88 billion in October on record imports
Data & Insights.summary: India's trade deficit widened to a one-year high of $39.88 billion in October due to a record surge in imports. Although both exports and imports experienced strong growth, the absolute increase in imports significantly outpaced export growth.

Data & Insights.title: Retail inflation hits 6.09% in October, crosses RBI's upper tolerance limit
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit of 6%. This increase reached a two-year high, aligning closely with economists' prior estimates.

Data & Insights.title: 'New state law to shield investors in Andhra Pradesh'
Data & Insights.summary: Andhra Pradesh is planning a new Investment Protection Act and escrow accounts to assure investors of policy continuity and incentives. Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu also intends to implement reforms to accelerate business growth in the state.

Data & Insights.title: Moody’s raises India’s FY27 growth forecast to 7%
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's has raised India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast to 7%. The agency expects the country to sustain this growth rate through 2028, driven by domestic demand and economic resilience.

Data & Insights.title: Moody's ups India's FY27 growth forecast to 7% on strong economic momentum, warns of risks
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's raised India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast from 6.5% to 7% due to strong momentum and resilience against energy shocks. However, the agency warned that inflationary pressures, a deficient monsoon, and rising El Niño risks could threaten this growth.

Data & Insights.title: Scientific research and granular data key to tackling climate, food security challenges: PK Mishra
Data & Insights.summary: PK Mishra stated that climate change is a broad crisis impacting agriculture, water, food prices, public health, and livelihoods rather than just an environmental issue. He emphasized that addressing these challenges and food security requires scientific research and detailed data.

India.title: Centre Extends Ban On Zakir Naik's Islamic Foundation For 5 More Years
India.summary: The Indian government has extended the ban on Zakir Naik's Islamic Research Foundation for another five years. Authorities stated that Naik used media and the internet to deliver radical statements that inspired youths to commit terrorist acts.

India.title: Kangana Ranaut Faces Police Case Over "Mysterious Foreigner" X Post On Sonia Gandhi
India.summary: Actor and politician Kangana Ranaut is facing a police complaint over an X post about Sonia Gandhi. The complainant alleges the post attempted to cast suspicion on the deaths of Indira, Sanjay, and Rajiv Gandhi.

India.title: Raj Thackeray Accuses BJP Of 'Exploiting Chhath', Draws Shiv Sena Retort
India.summary: Maharashtra Navnirman Sena chief Raj Thackeray accused the BJP of exploiting the Chhath festival and inciting communal tensions for electoral gains. In response, the Shiv Sena criticized Thackeray's remarks regarding the festival.

India.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Bengaluru Metro's Pink Line As It Joins 100 km Club
India.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated Bengaluru Metro's Pink Line, helping the city's metro network surpass the 100-kilometer milestone. He stated that the project reflects the nation's broader focus on improving travel convenience and overall quality of life.

India.title: Indian Seafarer Stranded At Karachi Port: India Makes Consular Request To Pakistan
India.summary: India has requested consular access from Pakistan for an Indian seafarer stranded at Karachi Port. The Indian External Affairs Ministry described the situation as a commercial dispute between the shipping company and its employee.

India.title: Chhath Puja: No Ghat In Delhi Is Fit For Bathing, But 3 Come Close
India.summary: None of the Chhath Puja bathing ghats in Delhi meet the central government's standard of 3 mg/L or less for biochemical oxygen demand. However, three ghats come close to meeting this water quality requirement.

General.title: Police investigating David Walliams over reports alleging serious sexual offences
General.summary: The Metropolitan Police are investigating comedian David Walliams following allegations of serious sexual offences. Police stated these new allegations are separate from those recently reported by ITV and the Guardian.

General.title: US Air Force says it responded to 'suspected drones' over RAF Lakenheath
General.summary: The US Air Force responded to suspected unauthorized drone activity over RAF Lakenheath. Officials confirmed there were no injuries or property damage resulting from the incident.

General.title: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption
General.summary: Microsoft apologized following a nearly 24-hour global technology outage that disrupted services worldwide. Experts noted the incident highlights the world's heavy reliance on a few major tech providers.

General.title: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
General.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin is increasing his demands for peace with Ukraine. Moscow views the inclusion of European security in these discussions as a major victory, according to BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg.

General.title: Former Hamas bodyguard guilty of UK knife attack
General.summary: Mohammed Alfatih was granted asylum in the UK in 2015 and British citizenship in 2020.

General.title: New campaign against EU membership launches ahead of UK-EU summit
General.summary: A new anti-EU membership campaign called Stay Out has launched ahead of the UK-EU summit. The launch coincides with preparations by Andy Burnham for discussions with European leaders next week.
